review: The 192-byte map at 0x54049A..0x54055A exactly tiles source bytes. It preserves wrapped and signed-bound comparison order, opaque child calls, the PC-relative data word at 0x5409D8, and subsequent structure writes from signed-int-to-binary32 conversions with architectural FP rounding/status controls. Repeated loads and post-child accesses are retained.
limitations: This is an incomplete continuation of the larger raw candidate; it does not establish a full function ABI, completion, or ownership.
Child contracts/effects and physical rendering, fault, alias, or concurrency behavior remain unresolved. FP architectural conditions are not qualified.
